name: BeLiquid initial liquidity-service prospect qualification
purpose: Rank publicly evidenced fit for BeLiquid Agency's Web3 liquidity-related services. This configuration is a draft and is not connected to live scoring.

criteria.label: Explicit liquidity need or initiative
criteria.positive_definition: An official project source explicitly describes a liquidity initiative, liquidity-provider search, market-making request, or comparable need relevant to BeLiquid's actual services.
criteria.unknown_when: No reliable public evidence confirms or rules out a relevant initiative.

criteria.label: Active product or protocol
criteria.positive_definition: A project has a verifiable product, protocol, application, or documented launch activity beyond a token profile alone.
criteria.unknown_when: The product's existence or current activity cannot be verified from available sources.

criteria.label: Recent, verifiable business trigger
criteria.positive_definition: A recent official announcement indicates a launch, exchange or chain expansion, ecosystem partnership, major product release, or another event plausibly relevant to liquidity services.
criteria.unknown_when: No reliable dated source was found or source freshness cannot be established.

criteria.label: Official project identity verified
criteria.positive_definition: A project-owned website or official documentation is identified and can be cross-checked against at least one other credible project-controlled or ecosystem source.
evidence_examples: ecosystem directory linking to the project
criteria.unknown_when: Only an unverified token profile, social link, or ambiguous domain is available.

criteria.label: Public, legitimate decision-maker path
criteria.positive_definition: A public business contact route or clearly identified team/business-development role is available from an official source.
criteria.unknown_when: No official, appropriate business contact route can be verified.

criteria.label: Evidence is current enough to act on
criteria.positive_definition: The key business trigger and project activity are supported by dated evidence within a configurable review window; default window is 180 days.
criteria.unknown_when: Evidence has no date, cannot be checked, or is outside the review window without a current corroborating source.

review_policy: A review flag requires human review regardless of score. A high score does not override risk flags.
approval_note: Weights and definitions are provisional. Approve or revise them before integrating this configuration into live lead scoring.
